rule: Versioned Rust expectation, separate from the frozen Python fixtures. ADR 0011 amends the hieronymus_recall response: the transport DTO serializes {recall_id, deterministic_contract, results, warnings}. The Python response was a bare ranked list, so the frozen mcp.json fixture stays untouched; this file pins the Rust delta instead. `results` is the normative key for the flattened ranked hits (the library field stays `hits`); `deterministic_contract` is computed before lane fusion and serialized whole even when `limit` removed every advisory hit; `warnings` carries structured degraded-mode notices (an armed-but-unavailable semantic lane degrades explicitly; an unarmed lane is simply absent).
